reason: node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA signature-verification flaw; no patched release is available as of 2026-10-02. Present only in word-addin devDependencies through office-addin-dev-certs -> mkcert and office-addin-debugging -> @microsoft/teamsfx-core. Their local certificate helpers generate/sign certificates and parse local key/certificate files; they do not call the vulnerable signature verifier. The production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs, not these development dependencies. REMOVE WHEN: node-forge publishes a patched release and these chains can resolve it; reassess if the dependency gains a production or signature-verification caller.

braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested brace patterns; published 2026-09-18 and no patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest braces). Present only in devDependencies: frontend through @ladle/react -> globby -> fast-glob -> micromatch, and word-addin through webpack-dev-server -> http-proxy-middleware -> micromatch (`npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty in every workspace). Those callers expand glob and proxy-path patterns written in this repo's own config, rather than user or document input. The frontend Docker image currently retains development dependencies, so this package is present in that image; the exception relies on these tooling call sites and controlled pattern inputs, not on image exclusion. The production Word add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs. REMOVE WHEN: braces publishes a patched release (or micromatch drops braces) and these chains resolve it; reassess if braces gains a production caller.

@azure/msal-node 6.0.1 authorization-code parameter disclosure, present in word-addin only through the devDependency office-addin-debugging -> office-addin-dev-settings -> @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli -> @azure/identity (`npm ls @azure/msal-node --omit=dev` is empty). That CLI signs a developer into Microsoft 365 for sideloading; the add-in has no MSAL code of its own and the production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs. The current upstream ranges require MSAL 6.x; this exception does not waive the advisory for any production dependency or other consumer. REMOVE WHEN: office-addin-debugging's declared range resolves @azure/msal-node >=7.1.0.
